title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC24 > AIFF > Final Cut > AIFF tracking via Audacity > FLAC24 via xACT)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix mix captures an ’82 monster show with a solid first set and a high‑energy second set full of classics.
ai_review.review: The upgraded matrix recording is described as “crystal clear” and “headphone gold,” delivering warm, roomy sound that lets listeners feel the room. The concert itself is praised for a tight first set and a monster second set featuring standout moments like China Cat Sunflower → The Rider, Black Peter, Crazy Fingers, Sailor, Saint of Circumstance, Touch and an exuberant double encore. Overall the performance radiates high energy and genuine fun.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, highlighting both an excellent matrix recording and a superb musical performance with no noted flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the audio crystal clear, warm, and headphone‑gold; the matrix blend restores sparkle missing from the original soundboard and provides an excellent sense of room ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid, upbeat first set leads into a monster second set with seamless transitions and a double encore that keeps the energy soaring.

band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted for his lively Bobby‑style Mick Jagger impersonation on Satisfaction.
